findings.title: First live pull: word arrived after the block deadline (Base Sepolia 0.2 s blocks)
findings.outcome: TimedOut (word after the 1,800-block deadline), refunded fee + settlement fee; VRF fee kept (it paid the request)
findings.cause: Base Sepolia produces blocks every 0.2 s (Base mainnet 2 s), so the 1,800-block deadline is ~6 min there; the testnet window was raised to 7,200 blocks through the timelock. The word itself was held back by the VRF float (next finding): it arrived just after the deadline, when the cheap timed-out callback fitted the subscription balance.

findings.title: VRF words waited for the subscription balance (Chainlink Max Cost at the lane max gas price)
findings.cause: The node fulfils only once the subscription covers the fulfilment at the key lane max gas price (30 gwei on Base Sepolia) x 1.6, the Max Cost in Chainlink billing docs; actual gas was 0.006 gwei. At 0.03-0.045 ETH every in-time multi-pull callback was above it, so words arrived only after the deadline (1,808 and 7,205 blocks: cheap timed-out callbacks). The single pull went through ~1 min after a top-up to 0.045 ETH (tx 0x65d836940dd92b4b0bc430758657901f1433c1b99eaa6f439709ab2d2c504717).
findings.outcome: After raising the float to 0.15 ETH (tx 0xf11d8d6030eafe40c6ca7a24aa7f54bc4915784751537b489265de57c138a2c1), words arrived in 12-14 blocks (2-3 s) for 1-, 7- and 8-pull batches. Mainnet 2 gwei lane needs ~0.0086 ETH; the preflight and keeper alert enforce 0.02 ETH.
